summary: Lower an arrow function by capturing the enclosing JavaScript this binding; never create a new this binding for the arrow.

target.notes: call/apply/bind cannot change arrow-function this. Capture the already-correct outer JS this value.

caveats: At top level, the meaning of outer this differs between scripts and modules.
Do not map an arrow to an instance delegate that accidentally captures a C# receiver instead of the JS this value.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Arrow Function Definitions
MDN JavaScript reference this / arrow functions

tests.name: captures method this
tests.input: const o={x:7,m(){ const f=()=>this.x; return f(); }}; console.log(o.m());
